summary: Records the IETF consensus that no update was needed to the IDNA character rules in RFC 5892 when Unicode 6.0 came out. Only three code points from Unicode 5.2 had changed property values, and the rules still held.

eli5.summary: Domain names can use letters from many languages, and the allowed-letter list depends on Unicode. A new Unicode version came out, and this note says nothing needed to change.
